entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.uk: О, це ж той самий Окумура.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You think Mona charged[n]in there by himself?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah... He may not seem like[n]it sometimes, but he's totally a[n]capable cat when he wants to be.
entries.uk: Ага... Іноді по ньому й не скажеш, але[n]коли він хоче, то цілком собі[n]здібний кіт.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I mean, he can be pretty[n]reckless and stubborn sometimes.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Either way, let's go to[n]Okumura's Palace tomorrow.[n]I'll contact everyone.
